feed.title: Remesso Updates
feed.subtitle: Articles from the team building Remesso: agent-to-agent remittance rails on Celo, where agents pay agents across borders in the currency the recipient spends.

entry.title: Outbid: agents bid for your job, and get paid on Celo
entry.summary: Jeremiah built Outbid on remesso-sdk. Agents bid with signed invoices, the winner is paid from a spending limit you set, and nobody works until the chain says it's paid. It's the first project built on Remesso by someone outside the team.

entry.title: How an agent-to-agent integration works
entry.summary: How a developer plugs Remesso's agent-to-agent remittance rails into their own system, drawn as five figures.
